rubric_title: LIFE707 Methods and Results Report Rubric

source.source_rubric_title: BIOS103 Methods and Results Assessment Rubric
source.translation_note: This is a structured Level 7 adaptation of the source PDF. It is not a Canvas export and has not been uploaded to Canvas.

level_and_marking.banding_note: The source's 'Adequate' rating scored 45% for every scored criterion. At Level 7 this is below the 50% pass mark, so it is renamed 'Borderline Fail'. A distinct 50% 'Pass' rating has been added.

canvas_import_mapping.api_shape: Create each entry in criteria as a Canvas rubric criterion; create each ratings entry as a rating for that criterion. Preserve points and description. Post-mark adjustments require an agreed workflow because zero-point Canvas rows do not automatically deduct a percentage.

criteria.long_description: Assesses the description of experimental design and practical steps, including the information needed to understand and repeat the work.

ratings.label: Exceptional
ratings.description: At the highest standard; this level should be extremely rare.

ratings.label: Outstanding
ratings.description: Exceptionally clear, accurate and concise account of design and procedure. Identifies relevant samples, groups, controls, replication, materials and conditions; the work can be repeated.

ratings.label: Excellent
ratings.description: Clear, accurate and well-organised account. Includes nearly all relevant design details and can be repeated with very few uncertainties.

ratings.label: Very Good
ratings.description: Clearly describes design and main procedural steps; most relevant details are included, with only minor omissions or unnecessary detail.

ratings.label: Good
ratings.description: Describes main steps, but important design, control, replication, material or condition details are missing or unclear. Parts would require assumptions to repeat.

ratings.label: Pass
ratings.description: Provides a basically accurate and usable account of the design and procedure. Core steps and enough information to understand the work are present, but important detail, rationale or reproducibility is limited.

ratings.label: Borderline Fail
ratings.description: Basic account of the procedure, but several details needed to understand design or repeat the work are missing or unclear. May include irrelevant detail or errors.

ratings.label: Marginal Fail
ratings.description: Incomplete or confusing account. Important design features and procedural details are absent or inaccurate, making repetition difficult.

ratings.label: Fail
ratings.description: Very little usable description; major steps or design features are missing or seriously inaccurate, so the work could not be repeated.

ratings.label: Absent
ratings.description: No assessable description of the experimental methods.

criteria.long_description: Assesses the description and critical justification of data organisation, processing, calculations, statistical analysis, assumptions and software.

ratings.label: Exceptional
ratings.description: At the highest standard; this level should be extremely rare.

ratings.label: Outstanding
ratings.description: Precise, complete and reproducible account of processing and analysis. Identifies calculations, summary statistics, exclusions or transformations, test/model, assumptions and software; choices are appropriate and critically justified.

ratings.label: Excellent
ratings.description: Clear and comprehensive account. Identifies main calculations, statistics, exclusions or transformations, test/model and software; assumptions and analytical choices are accurate with only minor omissions.

ratings.label: Very Good
ratings.description: Clearly describes main processing and analysis steps including principal calculations, statistics, test/model and software. Most relevant assumptions are addressed; a few details may be missing.

ratings.label: Good
ratings.description: Describes the general workflow but omits some important details of calculations, processing, exclusions, test/model, assumptions or software. Some choices may be insufficiently explained or contain minor errors.

ratings.label: Pass
ratings.description: Provides a basically correct account of the core processing and analysis. Key choices are named, but their rationale, assumptions, reproducibility or limitations are only partly addressed.

ratings.label: Borderline Fail
ratings.description: Basic analysis outline, but several steps are unclear or missing. Important information about processing, calculations, statistical method, assumptions or software is incomplete or may contain errors.

ratings.label: Marginal Fail
ratings.description: Analysis methods are incomplete or difficult to follow. Key processing steps or statistical methods are omitted or inappropriate, and errors undermine reproducibility.

ratings.label: Fail
ratings.description: Very little usable description of processing or analysis; major methods are missing or seriously incorrect.

ratings.label: Absent
ratings.description: No assessable description of processing or analysis methods.

criteria.long_description: At least two distinct figures are required. Assess relevance, accuracy, clarity and compliance with the specified figure guidance: labelled axes and units where relevant; no chart title; sequential numbering; and a descriptive caption below defining relevant symbols, variables and units.

ratings.label: Exceptional
ratings.description: At the highest standard; this level should be extremely rare.

ratings.label: Outstanding
ratings.description: At least two distinct, relevant and accurate figures. Each is clear and legible, correctly labelled, numbered and captioned; captions are self-contained and support interpretation.

ratings.label: Excellent
ratings.description: At least two relevant and accurate figures. They are clear, appropriately labelled and correctly placed, numbered and captioned, with only very minor lapses.

ratings.label: Very Good
ratings.description: At least two useful, mostly accurate and legible figures. Labels, units, numbering and captions are generally appropriate, with a few minor formatting or caption omissions.

ratings.label: Good
ratings.description: At least two figures, but one may be weakly chosen, unclear or contain errors. There are noticeable lapses in labels, units, titles, caption position, numbering or caption detail.

ratings.label: Pass
ratings.description: Two usable figures are provided and communicate the main findings, but relevance, accuracy, labelling, captions or formatting need substantial improvement.

ratings.label: Borderline Fail
ratings.description: Only one usable figure, or two or more figures with substantial problems in accuracy, legibility or required formatting. Captions or axis labels are incomplete and interpretation is limited.

ratings.label: Marginal Fail
ratings.description: One or more figures are unclear, inaccurate or poorly formatted. Required axis information or captions are largely missing, making them difficult to interpret.

ratings.label: Fail
ratings.description: No usable figures, or submitted figures are seriously inaccurate or uninterpretable.

ratings.label: Absent
ratings.description: No figures submitted.

criteria.long_description: At least one summary table is required. Assess accuracy and relevance of summary statistics and compliance with the specified table guidance: sequential numbering; descriptive caption above defining relevant symbols, variables and units; and sensible decimal places consistent with measurement precision.

ratings.label: Exceptional
ratings.description: At the highest standard; this level should be extremely rare.

ratings.label: Outstanding
ratings.description: Accurate, well-organised table with appropriate descriptive statistics, a sequential number, self-contained caption and suitable decimal precision.

ratings.label: Excellent
ratings.description: Accurate table with appropriate statistics. Caption, numbering and presentation enable interpretation, with only minor lapses.

ratings.label: Very Good
ratings.description: Mostly accurate and useful table. Caption, number and values are generally appropriate; a few minor details may be missing.

ratings.label: Good
ratings.description: A summary table is included, but has errors or omissions in statistics, labels, units or precision. The caption may be vague, incorrectly numbered or incomplete.

ratings.label: Pass
ratings.description: A usable table reports the main summary information, but accuracy, statistical appropriateness, labels, caption detail or precision need material improvement.

ratings.label: Borderline Fail
ratings.description: A table is present, but is incomplete, difficult to interpret or contains several errors. Caption placement/numbering may be incorrect or missing and precision may be unsuitable.

ratings.label: Marginal Fail
ratings.description: Substantially incomplete or inaccurate table, with major problems in summary values, labels or formatting. The caption is absent or does not support interpretation.

ratings.label: Fail
ratings.description: No usable summary table, or the table is seriously inaccurate and uninterpretable.

ratings.label: Absent
ratings.description: No summary table submitted.

criteria.long_description: Assesses accurate, concise reporting of findings and clear references to figures and the summary table by number.

ratings.label: Exceptional
ratings.description: At the highest standard; this level should be extremely rare.

ratings.label: Outstanding
ratings.description: Presents main findings accurately, logically and concisely. Directs the reader to all relevant figures and table by correct number and reports key numerical or statistical outcomes without unsupported claims.

ratings.label: Excellent
ratings.description: Presents findings clearly and accurately in logical order. Refers to relevant figures and table by number and reports key outcomes well, with only minor lapses in precision or concision.

ratings.label: Very Good
ratings.description: Mostly clear and accurate account of main findings. Refers to most figures and the table by number; may include some unnecessary detail or omit a minor result.

ratings.label: Good
ratings.description: Reports several relevant findings, but the narrative may be uneven, contain unnecessary detail, omit some references or include a few inaccuracies or unsupported statements.

ratings.label: Pass
ratings.description: Reports the core findings in a generally accurate and understandable way, but organisation, precision, figure/table signposting or distinction between results and interpretation needs improvement.

ratings.label: Borderline Fail
ratings.description: Basic account of findings, but unclear or incomplete in places. Figure/table references may be missing or incorrect and some statements may not match the displayed data.

ratings.label: Marginal Fail
ratings.description: Superficial or difficult-to-follow narrative that rarely guides the reader to figures/table and contains errors in describing findings.

ratings.label: Fail
ratings.description: Results narrative is largely absent or seriously inaccurate and incomplete; it does not communicate the findings.

ratings.label: Absent
ratings.description: No assessable results narrative.

non_scoring_rows.statement: This assessment is Tier 2: contextual support. Generative AI may be used only for the restricted and specified support activities stated in the assessment brief (for example, planning, editing or support tasks). It must not replace the student's own thinking or produce assessed content. Students must declare any GenAI use in line with the assessment brief, including the tool, purpose and how its output was used or checked.

ratings.label: No issues
ratings.description: A GAI declaration is provided with sufficient relevant details where GenAI was used.

ratings.label: Declaration needs clarification
ratings.description: A GAI acknowledgement is provided but contains insufficient relevant detail where GenAI was used. Follow the agreed assessment process before any deduction is applied.

ratings.label: No declaration
ratings.description: No GAI declaration is provided. Apply any agreed local process consistently; a zero-point rubric row cannot itself deduct marks in Canvas.

ratings.label: Refer to Academic Integrity Officer
ratings.description: There is evidence that GenAI was used beyond the stated Tier 2 permission or in a way that may constitute academic misconduct.

ratings.label: No concerns
ratings.description: There are no academic-integrity concerns with this assessment.

ratings.label: Category 1: Poor academic practice
ratings.description: If poor academic practice is formally identified, cap the assessment-task mark at 50%, the minimum Level 7 pass grade; give developmental feedback and follow the University process.

ratings.label: Refer to Academic Integrity Officer
ratings.description: Potential Category 2, 3 or 4 concern. Refer and follow the University Academic Integrity Policy; do not determine the outcome solely in the rubric.

pre_canvas_checks: Confirm that each criterion maps to the approved LIFE707 module learning outcomes and assessment brief.
Confirm whether marks may be entered between rating points; if not, retain the explicit 50% Pass ratings to avoid a gap at the Level 7 threshold.
Agree and document the workflow for any GAI declaration omission or mark adjustment before implementation.
Have the final rubric approved and moderated under the School's assessment process.
